data.ShortSpecHighlightContent: Designed for creators and gamers needing high-quality gaming experience.
AMD Ryzen™ 9 HX processor features 16 cores and max frequency 5.4 GHz.
Up to RTX 5080 delivers a maximum of 1334 AI TOPS.
Up to 2TB Gen 5 SSD storage offered, two SSD slots.
16" OLED display offers 240Hz refresh and low latency.

note: Note: some configurations are only available on selected models and may not be available in all regions
